measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, B, C, C where the asset was D, B, C, C: told apart
measured.lineupWhy:
The head is a rounded, low-detail blob with a flat pink face and no real facial features, unlike the sculpted faces on A to C.

The body is stubby and boxy, with short limbs and a bulky torso, where the other three have slim, anatomically proportioned builds.

The paint is flat, with pale, unshaded skin and clothing and plain colour blocks, while A to C have textured fabric, shading and detailed trim.
